Preserve every protection token exactly once and in order. Mandatory glossary translations must be used, corresponding English display text must not remain, and the meaning must not be simplified or changed.

Mandatory glossary rules:

Complete protected page:
* Hello, 世界

Welcome to a tour of the [[⟪GTI18N_3fbd6416_000001⟫][⟪GTI18N_3fbd6416_000002⟫ programming language]].

The tour is divided into a list of modules that you can
access by clicking on
[[⟪GTI18N_3fbd6416_000003⟫][⟪GTI18N_3fbd6416_000004⟫]] on the top left of the page.

You can also view the table of contents at any time by clicking on the [[⟪GTI18N_3fbd6416_000005⟫][menu]] on the top right of the page.

Throughout the tour you will find a series of slides and exercises for you
to complete.

You can navigate through them using

- [[⟪GTI18N_3fbd6416_000006⟫][⟪GTI18N_3fbd6416_000007⟫]] or ⟪GTI18N_3fbd6416_000008⟫ to go to the previous page,

- [[⟪GTI18N_3fbd6416_000009⟫][⟪GTI18N_3fbd6416_000010⟫]] or ⟪GTI18N_3fbd6416_000011⟫ to go to the next page.

The tour is interactive. Click the
[[⟪GTI18N_3fbd6416_000012⟫][⟪GTI18N_3fbd6416_000013⟫]] button now
(or press ⟪GTI18N_3fbd6416_000014⟫ + ⟪GTI18N_3fbd6416_000015⟫) to compile and run the program on
your computer.
The result is displayed below the code.

These example programs demonstrate different aspects of ⟪GTI18N_3fbd6416_000016⟫. The programs in the tour are meant to be starting points for your own experimentation.

Edit the program and run it again.

When you click on [[⟪GTI18N_3fbd6416_000017⟫][⟪GTI18N_3fbd6416_000018⟫]]
(shortcut: ⟪GTI18N_3fbd6416_000019⟫ + ⟪GTI18N_3fbd6416_000020⟫), the text in the editor is formatted using the
[[⟪GTI18N_3fbd6416_000021⟫][⟪GTI18N_3fbd6416_000022⟫]] tool. You can switch syntax highlighting on and off
by clicking on the [[⟪GTI18N_3fbd6416_000023⟫][syntax]] button.

When you're ready to move on, click the [[⟪GTI18N_3fbd6416_000024⟫][right arrow]] below or type the ⟪GTI18N_3fbd6416_000025⟫ key.
